passages.text: Material actions including decline communications, referral conclusions, quote progression, and core-system updates require accountable human approval. The agent prepares and recommends; the underwriter remains accountable.
Guideline answers must cite approved document, section, and page. If evidence is insufficient, abstain rather than invent guidance.
Protected-class attributes must not be used in appetite scoring or priority triage. Monitor proxy features such as ZIP code for disparate impact analysis.
